testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.ai.AiGovernanceTests

testcase.name: model access - deny rules at user, workspace and role level restrict models (most restrictive wins), audited, admin only()
money budgets - unknown price refused, soft and hard thresholds raise alerts, hard budget blocks paid models only()
SSE streaming - partial output arrives as deltas, final result carries provider-reported usage()
SSE streaming - the deadline stops a slow model with TIMEOUT()
SSE streaming - cancel keeps the partial output and records the call as CANCELLED, nothing is saved()
tool calling - server runs allowed tools with the user's permissions, refuses unknown ones, audits all, verifies reuse claims()
SSE streaming - a provider that ignores stream and answers JSON still works (one delta, usage kept)()
